name: Black Sesame International Holding Limited
summary: Black Sesame International Holding Limited, an investment holding company, provides autonomous driving system on chip (SoC) and SoC based solutions. The company's automotive-grade SoCs includes the Huashan series automotive grade high computing power autonomous driving chip; SesameX Platform, a full-stack self-evolving and whole-brain AI platform; hanhai autonomous driving middleware platform; and the Wudang series cross-domain computing platform for intelligent vehicles, such as advanced driving assistance system, smart cockpit, advanced imaging, and interconnection.
